question: Should OpenClaw adopt this Discord source-message progress feature with the proposed public configuration and channel lifecycle API, or require a narrower generic lifecycle seam before merge?
rationale: The implementation is well-proven, but it creates permanent configuration and plugin API surface plus a second completion callback path; that contract choice requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep feature, generalize seam
options.body: Retain the Discord behavior and configuration but replace the Discord-specific core lifecycle callback with an owner-approved generic settlement or progress contract.

options.title: Accept current contract
options.body: Approve the Discord-specific lifecycle callback and configuration hierarchy as supported long-term surface after conflict resolution and refreshed proof.

options.title: Do not sponsor
options.body: Decline the new core contract and revisit Discord source-message progress through a future owner-designed cross-channel proposal.

recommendation.title: Keep feature, generalize seam
recommendation.body: Retain the Discord behavior and configuration but replace the Discord-specific core lifecycle callback with an owner-approved generic settlement or progress contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the clearest available routing candidate who directly engaged with the Discord/subagent proposal.
